## Subdir Override

Project sets darkly, `_metadata.yml` sets flatly, this document in `subdir/`
overrides to vapor + a co-located `custom.scss`. Vapor (#170229) and the marker
(#e1d2c3) must appear; the path `custom.scss` resolves relative to this document.
